item.title: WARMING CENTERS IN MONTGOMERYT COUNTY
item.description: Need a place to get warm during the Arctic freeze. There are warming centers throughout Montgomery County that will be open during the duration of this winter storm. For more information on warming centers, call Montgomery County Office of Emergency Management: 936-523-3900
